decision: Danh tu san pham la "cong ty" va "ca nhan", KHONG phai "cong ty moi gioi" va "ca nhan moi gioi"
impact: tiet kiem: khong phai doi ten tren toan man hinh khi mang luoi mo linh vuc moi · rui ro: giai doan nay 100% la moi gioi nen ten rong hon thuc te, nguoi doc moi co the khong biet mang luoi gom ai

decision: Nhan cat theo NGU CANH (nhan chi mang phan man hinh chua cap), khong dung tieu de hai dong cung khong dung cuon ngang
impact: tiet kiem: gian toi da tu 3.0x xuong 1.8x, khong cot nao bi cat cut o kho hep, khong doi component bang · rui ro: nhan ngan chi dung TRONG man do — cung mot cot dat o man khac phai viet lai, nen kho chuoi khong dung chung nhan giua cac man

decision: KHONG lam nguon sinh cho thuoc so nhan vien giu tieng Viet sau mot tuan trong vong nay
impact: tiet kiem: vong ① khong phai dung duong do dac · rui ro: Cong Gia tri se doc bang nguong voi mot o CHUA DO, quyet release/iterate/kill mat mot can cu so
revisit: truoc khi mo Cong Gia tri cua ca nam vong

decision: KHONG viet bai kiem don vi cho LocaleProvider; chung minh that nam o ba phep do qua trinh duyet (E1/E2/E3)
impact: tiet kiem: khong dua mot khuon kiem-ve-React moi vao kho, noi moi bai kiem hien tai deu la ham thuan · rui ro: neu ba phep do trinh duyet khong chay duoc o buoc nghiem thu thi provider khong con phep do nao che

decision: Nut doi tieng la MOT DONG trong menu tai khoan, canh dong sang/toi — KHONG phai mot nut rieng o thanh dau trang nhu ke hoach viet
impact: tiet kiem: di dung nep san co cua kho, khong them nut moi vao thanh dau, khong dung kieu dang moi · rui ro: AC-10 da duyet viet nhu the nut doi tieng la mot nut rieng (Tab toi no roi Enter thi MENU mo ra); voi cach nay, Tab toi la toi nut menu tai khoan. Chat cua tieu chi — toi duoc bang ban phim, co vong tieu diem nhin thay, menu mo — van dung, nhung cau chu thi khong khop. NGUOI phe o Cong 2.

decision: DUNG va theo luat dung-va: AC-6 va AC-9 cung TRUOT vi mot ly do — hop dong hua ve mot man hinh ma chinh no cam sua component dung chung ve ra man hinh do
impact: lan thu HAI cung mot lop loi: phan bien bat o P0, toi va bang cach goi ten HAI ngoai le, vong cham chung minh danh sach ngoai le thieu. Khung sai chu khong phai chi tiet sai — nguoi chon duong, may khong tu va tiep
revisit: nguoi chon mot trong ba duong o Cong 2

decision: Nguoi chon Duong C: dao thu tu nam vong, dua vong 2 (bo dung chung) len truoc. Vong 1 DUNG o day, khong ky Cong 2
impact: Vong 1 giu nguyen phan da lam va da xanh. Hai phep do E6 va E9 con do, va ca hai chi dong duoc sau khi vong 2 mo duong cho component dung chung nhan chuoi tu ngoai
revisit: Vong 1 chay lai S4 ngay sau khi vong 2 dong
